newsitem.title: USA: Police finish identification of suicide victims.
newsitem.headline: Police finish identification of suicide victims.

text.p: Police investigating the mass suicide of 39 cult members said on Thursday they had identified all of the bodies but were not releasing the names of the dead until they notified relatives.
"We know who they are," Sgt. R.H. Morse told reporters outside the million-dollar mansion in this exclusive community near San Diego.
Morse said police had taken property from the house but he declined to say what was removed. He said there were several computers in the house.
Some 30 detectives and crime laboratory technicians from the San Diego Sheriff's Department were working on the case, and experts from the Los Angeles Coroner's Office were helping.
Morse said public administration officials were going through the house with the owner of the property. He described the interior of the house as tidy.
Police said the 39 men and women, dressed alike and with their hair in buzz cuts, appeared to have died from drug overdoses in a well-staged mass suicide over several days.
